text: AI is changing the workplace in many ways. Automation now handles repetitive tasks, such as sorting data or answering simple customer questions. This allows workers to focus on more creative and complex work. Many companies also use productivity tools powered by AI to manage schedules, write reports, or analyse information quickly. Instead of replacing people, AI often works alongside them. This human-AI collaboration can improve results and save time. However, some jobs are changing or disappearing, so employees need new skills like digital literacy and problem-solving. Overall, AI offers great opportunities, but workers must adapt to keep up with these changes.
